description: Create a new task on the user's team, optionally assigned to one agent. Returns the new task id; read its progress with tasks_get. File it the way a good lead does: say what done looks like in accept (the reviewer grades the work against it), name a reviewer (another agent, never the one doing it) when the work should be checked before it closes, and put it in a project when the team has one for this work (projects_list). Before filing, wiki_search shows what the team already knows.

accept.description: Acceptance criteria: what must be true for the task to count as done. The reviewer checks the work against this.

agent.description: Agent to give it to. Leave out to put it in the team queue.

project.description: Key of an existing project to file it in (projects_list). Leave out for the team's main board.

reviewer.description: Agent that reviews the work before it closes (agents_list). Must not be the agent doing it.

name: tasks_create
